body: Waking at dawn. A Mediterranean garden steeped in scent. A majestic fig tree. An irresistible craving. Milky, crisp fruits. A suspended, eternal pleasure.

title: 001 (2.5ml): Orange blossom, petitgrain, bergamot
body: A must-have we all love for its comforting and ever-elegant softness. A sparkling trio of citrus notes enlivens this timeless cologne. Bergamot and lavender blend with the sweetness of orange blossom, while musky base notes provide staying power. Much more than just a fresh cologne, it clings to our skin.

title: 002 (2.5ml): Neroli, jasmine, white amber
body: As if you were being offered a bouquet of luminous flowers... A lively opening with bergamot that meets the luminosity of neroli and jasmine. These flowers are joined by the softness of musk and white amber.

title: 003 (2.5ml): Yuzu, violet leaves, vetiver
body: Our revisited version of Cologne. A sparkling and zesty opening with yuzu, the Japanese cousin of lemon! Powdery white floral tones bring softness and elegance to this playful fragrance. Hints of elemi enchant and add facets to the woody and musky notes in the base. A little playful but always fresh.

title: 004 (2.5ml): Gin, mandarin, musk
body: A gin and tonic effect brought by juniper berry. A veritable citrus cocktail accompanies it: lemon, bergamot, and mandarin form a vibrant echo. Then, a hint of nutmeg stirs our hearts. In the base, patchouli and tonka bean warm and lend staying power to the fragrance. A cologne that will delight the mixologist hidden within you.

title: 101 (2.5ml): Rose, sweet pea, white cedar
body: A queenly fragrance for the queen of flowers: sweet and fresh like a rose garden. The opening notes are green and spicy with cardamom. The heart is rose and sweet pea. Damask rose is used in absolute and essence. In the base, musk and white cedar bring a powdery softness.

title: 102 (2.5ml): Tea, cardamom, mimosa
body: An explosion of colors: sparkling bergamot, coriander, and cardamom! This clever blend offers a scent of green tea. Grasse mimosa plays the leading role in the heart of this creation, supported by powdery jasmine. Musks and oakmoss in the background warm the trail.

title: 103 (2.5ml): Tiare flower, jasmine, hibiscus
body: Like a holiday feeling: as soft as the sun on the skin. The fragrance opens with fresh notes of bergamot and neroli. Then, tiare flower, jasmine, and hibiscus transport us to a warm sandy beach. The vanilla and musky base reveals a milky trail reminiscent of the sweetness of monoi and soothing holiday memories.

title: 104 (2.5ml): Green orange, hyacinth, ivy
body: A stroll through Grasse, a city of a thousand scents, a city of leather craftsmanship and flowers. The bells ring, night falls on the heights of the peaceful city, and the tuberoses exhale their narcotic scent. Combining twilight tuberose with tanned leather—a tribute to Grasse's heritage. A creamy tuberose under a protective suede cloche.

title: 105 (2.5ml): Mandarin, cinnamon, sandalwood
body: An androgynous composition, sometimes floral, sometimes spicy! Mandarin and geranium offer us this scent of imaginary roses. A trio of spices with tones adds a twist to the creation: saffron, cinnamon, and cardamom. Creamy sandalwood warms and envelops this spicy rose.

title: 106 (2.5ml): Rose damascena, davana, vanilla
body: A sensual and daring fragrance perfect for night owls. Intoxicating and sweet, Damascus rose radiates throughout the fragrance. A twist of pink pepper brings a touch of freshness. Then, velvety rose petals blend with the creation's musky and vanilla notes.

title: 107 (2.5ml): Tuberose, saffron, suede leather
body: A stroll through Grasse, a city of a thousand scents, a city of leather craftsmanship and flowers. The bells ring, night falls on the heights of the peaceful city, and the tuberoses exhale their narcotic scent. Combining twilight tuberose with tanned leather—a tribute to Grasse's heritage. A creamy tuberose under a protective suede cloche.

title: 201 (2.5ml): Green apple, lily of the valley, quince
body: Like an apple sorbet. The lively, crisp notes of fruit play with the sparkling facets of bergamot. Green apple and blackcurrant leaf open the fragrance with a fresh, vegetal dimension. One could imagine an orchard! The heart is a magnificent bouquet of magnolia and lily-of-the-valley flowers. The woody intensity of cedar and vetiver, combined with musks, reinforces the staying power of this airy fragrance.

title: 202 (2.5ml): Watermelon, redcurrant, jasmine
body: A truly refreshing fruit cocktail. Citrus, watermelon, and watermelon blend with the more velvety facets of jasmine and lily of the valley. These white flowers breathe a breath of lightness over the soft sandalwood.

title: 203 (2.5ml): Raspberry, vanilla, blackberry
body: A playful and indulgent red fruit fragrance! Warmed by a floral hint of neroli and jasmine, raspberry illuminates the entire creation. Vanilla, white wood, and musks intertwine to form a single, seamless unit with the fragrance.

title: 301 (2.5ml): Amber, cardamom, sandalwood
body: Like a battle between hot and cold spices, between cumin and cardamom. A tension that makes the entire fragrance vibrate. It gives volume and carries sandalwood, the main character of this perfume. The rich and intense facets of this wood are revealed, soft and milky. The warmth of amber accompanies the sandalwood and gives the perfume a trail.

title: 302 Eau de Parfum
body: If temptation had a scent, this would be it. It begins with a spicy top note led by pink peppercorn. Iris sets the stage, revealing its floral facets with a velvety feel. The base ignites and raises the temperature with sandalwood, amber, and musk.

title: 303 (2.5ml): Chili pepper, pink berry, benzoin
body: A night in the gardens of the Taj Mahal. The vegetation is warm, the moon is sunny, the marble palace is illuminated. Cold spices swathed in balmy benzoin.

body: A walk after a torrent of rain. Rays of sunshine after the storm, glimpsed through the foliage of the undergrowth. An overdose of pepper, pungent incense, and wet earth. Cold spices scattered through amber woods. Unexplained addiction, captivating scents.

title: 603 (2.5ml): Leather, incense, tonka
body: The scent of burning incense circulates, intersects, and intertwines, trapped within the walls of the Golden Temple in India. Sparks of incense in a leather glove.

title: 701 (2.5ml): Eucalyptus, coriander, cypress
body: A fragrance that makes you soar! First, a great, slightly fruity freshness and a hint of bitterness brought by the grapefruit and pineapple duo. 701 is an explosion of spices and herbs: pepper, rosemary, coriander, eucalyptus, cypress. They raise the temperature, and blend wonderfully with amber wood and incense.

title: 702 (2.5ml): Incense, lavender, cashmere wood
body: The scent of a Parisian barbershop! The initial sparkling, citrusy notes of elemi give way to incense. The woody-aromatic heart opens with a trio of lavender, cedar, and cashmere wood. The vanilla-musk base brings a powerful, rounded feel to this creation.

title: 801 (2.5ml): Sea spray, cedar, grapefruit
body: Sea, spray, and sun! Like a breeze of sea spray caressing our faces, 801 is refreshing with its grapefruit opening. This breeze intensifies, swirling spices: pink pepper and nutmeg add a hint of spice. Rows of cedar and cypress trees diffuse their sun-dried wood into the air. A summer fragrance to wear all year round.

title: 802 (2.5ml): Peony, lotus, bamboo
body: Like waking up in a Japanese garden. Lotus flower and bamboo combine for a Zen, plant-like freshness. Crafted around a floral bouquet of freesia, peony, and osmanthus, this fragrance reminds us of the scent of morning dew. The airy musks prolong this bubble of softness.

title: 803 (2.5ml): Sea spray, ginger, patchouli

Then, tiare flower, jasmine, and hibiscus transport us to a warm sandy beach. The vanilla and musky base reveals a milky trail reminiscent of the sweetness of monoi and soothing holiday memories.

title: 105 YMC
body: An androgynous composition, sometimes floral, sometimes spicy! Mandarin and geranium offer us this scent of imaginary roses. A trio of spices with tones adds a twist to the creation: saffron, cinnamon, and cardamom. Creamy sandalwood warms and envelops this spicy rose.

title: 201 Gold September
body: Like an apple sorbet. The lively, crisp notes of fruit play with the sparkling facets of bergamot. Green apple and blackcurrant leaf open the fragrance with a fresh, vegetal dimension. One could imagine an orchard! The heart is a magnificent bouquet of magnolia and lily-of-the-valley flowers. The woody intensity of cedar and vetiver, combined with musks, reinforces the staying power of this airy fragrance.

title: 202 Eau de parfum
body: A truly refreshing fruit cocktail. Citrus, watermelon, and watermelon blend with the more velvety facets of jasmine and lily of the valley. These white flowers breathe a breath of lightness over the soft sandalwood.

title: 301 Noces de Santal
body: Like a battle between hot and cold spices, between cumin and cardamom. A tension that makes the entire fragrance vibrate. It gives volume and carries sandalwood, the main character of this perfume. The rich and intense facets of this wood are revealed, soft and milky. The warmth of amber accompanies the sandalwood and gives the perfume a trail.

title: 302 Groovy Amber
body: If temptation had a scent, this would be it. It begins with a spicy top note led by pink peppercorn. Iris sets the stage, revealing its floral facets with a velvety feel. The base ignites and raises the temperature with sandalwood, amber, and musk.

title: 401 Prune Velours
body: A fragrant liqueur with fruity and vanilla accents. A fresh and tangy trio of cypress, elemi, and bergamot begins. Then, plum reveals sweet and captivating tones of candied fruit, balanced by the elegance of cedarwood. Vanilla gives this creation a bold character, adding roundness and sensuality.

title: 601 Nuit Vétiver
body: Timeless elegance in a bottle. Sparkling and fresh notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper. The heart notes are violet leaf, bringing a vegetal dimension. Vetiver and cedar, with their intense and rich woody facets, are then discovered in the background. A distinguished and chic olfactory signature.

title: 701 Eau De Cyprès

First, a great, slightly fruity freshness and a hint of bitterness brought by the grapefruit and pineapple duo. 701 is an explosion of spices and herbs: pepper, rosemary, coriander, eucalyptus, cypress. They raise the temperature, and blend wonderfully with amber wood and incense.

title: 702 Encens Privé
body: The scent of a Parisian barbershop! The initial sparkling, citrusy notes of elemi give way to incense. The woody-aromatic heart opens with a trio of lavender, cedar, and cashmere wood. The vanilla-musk base brings a powerful, rounded feel to this creation.

title: 801 Blu Palermo
body: Sea, spray, and sun! Like a breeze of sea spray caressing our faces, 801 is refreshing with its grapefruit opening. This breeze intensifies, swirling spices: pink pepper and nutmeg add a hint of spice. Rows of cedar and cypress trees diffuse their sun-dried wood into the air. A summer fragrance to wear all year round.

title: 802 Nymphéa Céleste
body: Like waking up in a Japanese garden. Lotus flower and bamboo combine for a Zen, plant-like freshness. Crafted around a floral bouquet of freesia, peony, and osmanthus, this fragrance reminds us of the scent of morning dew. The airy musks prolong this bubble of softness.

title: 901 Soir Tonka
body: A shot of energy and spice. Ginger awakens the first fresh notes of grapefruit. Nutmeg and black pepper add spice, while almond reveals its sweetness and opens the transition to suave vanilla facets. Patchouli and musk leave sensual scents on the skin.

title: 902 Hazy Spice

title: 904 Ice Tobacco

title: 003 French Yuzu

title: Eau de Parfum 004 - 15ml

In the base, we find patchouli and tonka bean, which warms and provides staying power. A cologne that will delight the mixologist hidden within you.

title: 402 Guilty Vanilla
body: Place des Vosges, Paris. A smooth vanilla cream in a powdery sandalwood. Caramelized indulgence. An overdose of sweetness.

title: Eau de Parfum 101 - 15ml
body: A queenly fragrance for the queen of flowers: sweet and fresh like a rose garden. The opening notes are green and spicy with cardamom. The heart is rose and sweet pea. Damask rose is used in absolute and essence. In the base, musk and white cedar bring a powdery softness.

title: 501 Praline Royale
body: Children’s eyes fixed on the oven. Crunchy praline within a heart of powdery iris. A case of cashmere wood. Syrupy liquorice.

title: Eau de Parfum 102 - 15ml
body: An explosion of colors: sparkling bergamot, coriander, and cardamom! This clever blend offers a scent of green tea. Grasse mimosa plays the leading role in the heart of this creation, supported by powdery jasmine. Musks and oakmoss in the background warm the trail.

title: 601 Nuit Vétiver
body:
A night-time promenade through Paris.
Fresh vetiver. Crossing the majestic bridges under the moon.
Violet leaves and elegant cedarwood.
An eternity carved in wood.

title: Eau de parfum 103 - 15ml
body: Like a holiday feeling: as soft as the sun on the skin. The fragrance opens with fresh notes of bergamot and neroli. Then, tiare flower, jasmine, and hibiscus transport us to a warm sandy beach. The vanilla and musky base reveals a milky trail reminiscent of the sweetness of monoi and soothing holiday memories.

title: 602 Bois Narcotique
body: The rain has stopped, but the scent remains. Water glides along the branches, the leaves shiver. Peppery notes drift through a forest wander. Footsteps fade into the soaked forest path.

title: Eau de Parfum 106 - 15ml
body: A sensual and daring fragrance perfect for night owls. Intoxicating and sweet, Damascus rose radiates throughout the fragrance. A twist of pink pepper brings a touch of freshness. Then, velvety rose petals blend with the creation's musky and vanilla notes.

title: Eau de parfum 201 - 15ml
body: Like an apple sorbet. The lively, crisp notes of fruit play with the sparkling facets of bergamot. Green apple and blackcurrant leaf open the fragrance with a fresh, vegetal dimension. One could imagine an orchard! The heart is a magnificent bouquet of magnolia and lily-of-the-valley flowers. The woody intensity of cedar and vetiver, combined with musks, reinforces the staying power of this airy fragrance.

title: 701 Eau de Cyprès
body: Lunch in Camargue, in a garden of aromatics. A fragrant breeze, gentle sunlight. Words, scents, and emotions intertwine. Nature takes its place at the table.

title: 702 Encens Privé
body: Father and son, a morning ritual. Watching him shave, mimicking each gesture. Lavender and aromatic youth; amber woods and quiet precision. Mystical and spicy incense.

title: 801 Blu Palermo
body: Sicily. A cruise with friends. Musky wind, sea spray. Awakening, a bracing freshness, a sudden storm. Then, the calm. Alone in the world.

title: 802 Nymphéa Céleste
body: Beyond time, by the water’s edge. Aquatic bamboo, nymphea, enveloping musks. Meditation. Trees and thoughts reaching toward the sky.

title: 901 Soir Tonka
body: Autumn evening in Paris, velvet sofa, roaring fire. Golden light lingers. Spicy patchouli, opulent tonka. A signature fragrance. The Maison's first creation.

title: Eau de parfum 202 - 15ml
body: A truly refreshing fruit cocktail. Citrus, watermelon, and watermelon blend with the more velvety facets of jasmine and lily of the valley. These white flowers breathe a breath of lightness over the soft sandalwood.

title: 902 Hazy Spice
body:
Poker game. Cigars.
A swirl of spice on a dark bed of labdanum.
Place your bets, the game is on.
A sip of Armagnac, a curl of tobacco smoke.

title: Eau de parfum 301 - 15ml
body: Like a battle between hot and cold spices, between cumin and cardamom. A tension that makes the entire fragrance vibrate. It gives volume and carries sandalwood, the main character of this perfume. The rich and intense facets of this wood are revealed, soft and milky. The warmth of amber accompanies the sandalwood and gives the perfume a trail.

title: Eau de parfum 203 - 15ml
body: A playful and indulgent red fruit fragrance! Warmed by a floral hint of neroli and jasmine, raspberry illuminates the entire creation. Vanilla, white wood, and musks intertwine to form a single, seamless unit with the fragrance.

title: Eau de parfum 302 - 15ml
body: If temptation had a scent, this would be it. It begins with a spicy top note led by pink peppercorn. Iris sets the stage, revealing its floral facets with a velvety feel. The base ignites and raises the temperature with sandalwood, amber, and musk.

title: Eau de parfum 401 - 15ml
body: A fragrant liqueur with fruity and vanilla accents. A fresh and tangy trio of cypress, elemi, and bergamot begins. Then, plum reveals sweet and captivating tones of candied fruit, balanced by the elegance of cedarwood. Vanilla gives this creation a bold character, adding roundness and sensuality.

title: Eau de parfum 501 - 15ml
body: The scent of our first childhood pleasures! Hazelnut sets the tone, then in the heart, praline and licorice form a bubble of sweetness. A powdery iris launches the transition to musky notes. A deliciously addictive fragrance, with a strong trail of patchouli!

title: Eau de parfum 402 - 15ml
body: A millefeuille of vanilla, caramel, and wood. Almond blossom enhances the vanilla and caramel with its powdery and floral facets. Sandalwood, sweet and milky, warms this fragrance. A terribly addictive scent on the skin.

title: Eau de parfum 602 - 15ml

title: Eau de parfum 601 - 15ml
body: Timeless elegance in a bottle. Sparkling and fresh notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper. The heart notes are violet leaf, bringing a vegetal dimension. Vetiver and cedar, with their intense and rich woody facets, are then discovered in the background. A distinguished and chic olfactory signature.
